exposure: Mode of birth (primary Cesarean section delivery)
cohort: The study included 123 infants >= 34 weeks GA who died from SUID in New Jersey between 2000 and 2015, with 24 deaths occurring in the first week of life.
finding: The study found that SUID in the first week of life had different risk patterns compared to the remainder of the first month, with first-week deaths showing a higher percentage of mothers with post-High School education and primary Cesarean section delivery, and a smaller percentage with inadequate prenatal care.
mod_finding: Deaths in the first week of life had a higher percentage of mothers who had a primary Cesarean section delivery (OR 4.0, CI: 1.39-11.49).
